messages:
Nadia: quick follow-up from the RFC reviews: we need a clearer plan for probe gating when adapters advertise quantization/eviction differences across hosted/dedicated/private.
Emir: agreed. observed a delta where dedicated adapters advertise `int8` but runtime falls back to `fp16` because eviction policy differs. we should capture policy hints in the probe.
Tao: proposal: probe returns capability + runtime-policy-hints only (no model data). runtime then picks model variant or rejects if mismatch. keeps control plane small.
Clara: can we standardize the policy hint keys? suggested minimal keys: `eviction_strategy`, `kv_cache_guarantee`, `quant_precision`.
Nadia: example probe payload (for implementers):
```json
{
  "capabilities": ["streaming","rerank"],
  "quant_precision": "int8",
  "eviction_strategy": "best-effort",
  "kv_cache_guarantee": "soft",
  "feature_versions": {"kv_cache":"v2"}
}
```
Emir: ops note: label the probe response with `X-Adapter-Compat` and a short hash so runtime can cache compatibility results instead of re-evaluating every request.
Tao: security: probe must not include any customer prompts or secret references. add `no_secret_proxy: true` default and an `allowlist` string only for enterprise.
Clara: rollout plan idea: gate by adapter version header `X-RW-Adapter-Ver`. control plane keeps a small compatibility table, and we ship an SRE playbook: fallback route to full-manifest adapters + alerting.
Nadia: tradeoffs to call out in the RFC blurb: smaller probes reduce latency and memory in hosted, but increases adapter-side logic for fallback. Also we temporarily carry two code paths.
Emir: testing reqs: unit schema check, integration test that does probe -> resolve -> model call with mismatched quantization, and canary traffic where 0.1% goes to legacy manifest flow.
deploy-bot: scheduled RFC update merge window: 2026-07-12 17:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/adapter-probe-eviction-quantization :zap:
Tao: implementers: include `feature_versions` map and `compat_hint` short string in probe; runtime can use fast-path when compat_hint matches.
Clara: also add metrics tag `adapter_probe_mode=capabilities_only|manifest_fallback` so we can measure adoption. set alert if fallback >5% for 48h.
Nadia: i'll update the RFC with the probe shape, the compat hash idea, and the canary checklist. pinging eng-runtime, eng-platform, and eng-sre for review.
Emir: free sync tomorrow 11am PT for final sign-off.
Tao: i'll put together the integration test scaffold and a small sample adapter.
Clara: i'll draft the SRE canary playbook and share in #eng-sre.
Nadia: thanks team. short follow-up thread after the RFC merge? :thumbsup:
